name: unter-b2b-monorepo
description: Unter b2b - Crowd-sourced B2B micro-freight MVP connecting local businesses with couriers' unused trunk capacity.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --workspace=packages/backend run build && npm --workspace=packages/frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace=packages/backend run test && npm --workspace=packages/frontend run typecheck
